title: Fall cleanup and leaf guide for Greater Victoria

seo.title: Fall Garden Cleanup & Leaf Guide for Victoria, BC
seo.description: What to cut back, what to leave and how to handle leaves in Greater Victoria's wet fall, plus lawn care and drainage checks before winter storms.

summary: What to cut back, what to leave and how to deal with leaves before the winter rain.

body.p: Fall on southern Vancouver Island means the rain returns, leaves come down in large amounts and soil stays warm enough for roots to grow. It is a good season to plant and to get the garden ready for winter storms.

list: Keep leaves off lawns; a wet mat smothers grass and invites moss.
Clear leaves from drains, gutters and walkways where they become slippery.
Use healthy leaves as mulch on beds or add them to compost.
Check your municipality's yard-waste collection or drop-off options for the rest.
Cut back perennials that collapse into mush, such as hostas.
Leave sturdy seed heads and grasses for winter structure and birds.
Remove diseased foliage rather than composting it.
Aerate and overseed in early fall while the soil is warm.
Lower mowing frequency as growth slows, but do not cut too short before winter.

body.p: Fall is a good time to plant trees, shrubs and many perennials. Rain does most of the watering and roots grow through the mild winter. See [native and drought-tolerant planting](/resources/native-and-drought-tolerant-planting/).
Do not put invasive plants in your yard-waste bin or compost. The CRD explains how to dispose of them; knotweed needs special handling and is not accepted at municipal yard-waste drop-offs.
Shut down and winterize your system before the first hard frost. See our [irrigation start-up and winterization guide](/resources/irrigation-start-up-and-winterization/).
Book a fall cleanup through [grounds maintenance](/services/grounds-maintenance/) or [get a free quote](/free-quote/).
Drop-off dates and disposal rules change from year to year. Check the CRD page linked below and your municipality before you haul garden waste. We wrote this guide in November 2026.
